title: Type toggle has no selected/focusable option when factor.banding is 'continuous'
description: The Type ToggleButtonGroup only offers options 'breakpoints' and 'categorical' (lines 354-357), but a factor's banding can legitimately be 'continuous' (the default from normaliseBandingFactors, from addFactor/duplicateFactor, and from older/pasted configs). When such a configured factor is shown, `value={factor.banding}` ('continuous') matches neither option, so in ToggleButtonGroup every button has aria-checked=false and tabIndex=-1 (ToggleButtonGroup.tsx lines 49-56). The radiogroup then has no keyboard-focusable member, and the user sees a toggle with nothing selected even though the factor is in a real mode. Switching away is possible by click, but the control misrepresents and is not Tab-reachable in that state.
evidence: options=[{key:'breakpoints'},{key:'categorical'}] (lines 355-356). ToggleButtonGroup computes active=value===opt.key and sets tabIndex={active?0:-1}; with value='continuous' both actives are false => all tabIndex=-1, none aria-checked. addFactor creates banding:'continuous' (line 91) and duplicateFactor copies src.banding; a duplicated/added factor that later gets a column set reaches shouldShowTypeToggle while still 'continuous'.
